hassan2.name: Hassan II Mosque
hassan2.price_text: ≈ MAD 130–150 guided tour; check on the day
hassan2.hours: Guided visits several times daily except during prayers · check on the day
hassan2.tip: Book a morning tour slot and arrive early; cover arms, legs and hair, and remove shoes inside.
hassan2.best: Morning tour, or outside at sunset

crazy_park.name: Crazy Park
crazy_park.price_text: Entry price varies by ride · check on the day
crazy_park.hours: Typically daytime into evening · check on the day
crazy_park.tip: Good for families with kids; confirm opening hours and ride prices before you go.

loupi_park.name: Loupi Park Land
loupi_park.price_text: Entry price varies by activity · check on the day
loupi_park.hours: Typically daytime · check on the day
loupi_park.tip: A play park for younger children; call ahead to confirm it is open.

magic_forest.name: Magic Forest
magic_forest.price_text: Entry price varies · check on the day
magic_forest.hours: Typically daytime · check on the day
magic_forest.tip: Family-friendly green space; confirm hours and prices locally before visiting.

parc_sindibad.name: Parc Sindibad
parc_sindibad.price_text: Entry price varies · check on the day
parc_sindibad.hours: Typically daytime · check on the day
parc_sindibad.tip: Amusement park near the coast; check which rides are running before you buy tickets.

stade_mohammed_v.name: Stade Mohammed V
stade_mohammed_v.price_text: Match tickets vary · check on the day
stade_mohammed_v.hours: Only on match or event days · check on the day
stade_mohammed_v.tip: Catch a Raja or Wydad match for the atmosphere; buy tickets through official channels only.

central_market.name: Marché Central (Central Market)
central_market.price_text: Free to browse · meals paid separately
central_market.hours: Morning to early evening · check on the day
central_market.tip: Walk the fish and produce stalls, then eat at one of the small restaurants inside.

habous_walk.name: Quartier Habous walk
habous_walk.tip: Wander the arcades and souk streets; dress modestly near the mosques.

corniche_walk.name: Corniche seaside walk
corniche_walk.tip: Walk west along the waterfront at sunset for sea views and the mosque silhouette.

old_medina.name: Old Medina of Casablanca
old_medina.tip: Explore the narrow lanes near the port; keep valuables close and go with a local guide if unsure.

food_tour.name: Casablanca street food tasting walk
food_tour.price_text: ≈ MAD 200–400 per person · check on the day
food_tour.tip: Sample msemen, harira and mint tea; confirm what is included and whether pickup is offered.

anfa_view.name: Anfa waterfront viewpoint
anfa_view.tip: A calm spot for ocean views and photos; go in the cooler late afternoon.

beach_day.name: Ain Diab beach
beach_day.price_text: Free public beach · private clubs charge
beach_day.tip: Public stretches are free; private beach clubs charge for access and sunbeds.

ville_walk.name: Centre Ville art deco walk
ville_walk.tip: Look up at the 20th-century facades around Place Mohammed V and the old post office.
